summary: This flow diagram titled 'AI Design Process' outlines the steps involved in designing an AI system. It consists of five key steps: 1) Define the Problem and Objective, which involves identifying the issue the AI needs to address; 2) Choose an algorithm and framework, focusing on supervised, unsupervised, or deep learning methods; 3) Define the Agent's Architecture, determining how the AI will learn from its mistakes, potentially through a reward or loss system; 4) Train the Agent, utilizing data to enhance the AI's skills until it reaches an acceptable level; and 5) Share and Evaluate the Agent, assessing its performance in real-world scenarios. The diagram visually represents these steps in a circular format, emphasizing the iterative nature of the AI design process.
